The Petitioner has stated that in view of the provisions of sub-sections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, the Petitioner, as a licensee, cannot create a Security Interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of a Security Trustee acting on behalf of lender pursuant to a Loan Agreement dated 21.12.2023 and a Security Trustee Agreement dated 21.12.2023 without approval of the Commission.
